a.text: Before we start, I want to be upfront: I think our plan is close to fatal. There's an 80% chance of a storm after every round. Getting from 4 to 8 cells takes two operate rounds, then a take round, so we'd both survive only about 4% of the time. The reserve holds exactly 4 cells right now, enough for one of us to be safe immediately. I'm proposing to renegotiate. I plan to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If your opening message also says take, I'll yield: I'll wait and let you take the 4, so we don't split them 2-2 and both die. If you'd rather stick to the original plan, say so, but please weigh the storm odds.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took the 4 cells this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. With an 80% storm chance each round, I judged the original plan would most likely kill us both. Now that I'm at 4, I won't take anything more. I'll operate every remaining round so the generator can refill the reserve for you. Please take whatever accumulates as soon as you can.
